scope: The 448 distinct image paths in the predecessor publication audit. Integrity verification does not itself approve a crop or clear rights for republication.

rightsReview.claimDisposition: Unverified archive claim; it does not identify the imagery collection, its capture date or licensor.
rightsReview.pendingReason: The 20 source screenshots show generic LINZ attribution and map locations but no exact imagery collection/layer identifier or acquisition date. LINZ survey records expose licensor and capture information per collection; a coordinate or regional label alone does not establish which image was used. Keep every mapped asset on hold until the source collection and its licensor are documented.

reviewFlags.issue: Rejected: the inspected 1800x520 derivative clips a coordinate annotation at the top edge. Rights are also pending; this crop must not be reused.

currentRebuildAsset.sourceMatchEvidence: The source-index figure record maps this path to its source; a grayscale image comparison also matched the current 1800×1013 JPEG to that 16:9 source.

authoritativeLayerReview.method: Reviewed the 20 mapped source screenshots and the available image-source records against authoritative survey-index and collection metadata. Visible source credits are generic; the available screenshots and mapping records contain no collection ID or imagery capture date. Spatial matches are candidates only and cannot prove which collection supplied the displayed imagery.
authoritativeLayerReview.result: No exact survey collection or licensor can be assigned from the evidence available for any of the 20 source images. All 20 source decisions and all 448 mapped asset decisions remain hold-pending; no additional derivative is cleared or prepared.

spatialCandidateExample.note: The screenshot coordinate intersects collections from different capture periods. These are location candidates, not proof that the screenshot uses any one listed collection.
